thread:
maria: Great AH — thanks for the turnout. Quick follow-up from the Dedicated GA Q&A: here's a concise plan for launch readiness, SLAs, and customer onboarding. Links at the bottom. :rocket:
jon: GA date recap? I thought it was 'Q3-ish' but need a concrete day to align sales messaging.
maria: target GA: 2026-08-15. soft-launch window: 2026-08-15 -> 2026-09-15 (invite-only customers). Broad GA: 2026-09-16.
diego: SLA numbers we promised during the call? latency p95 / uptime?
maria: SLA targets: 99.95% uptime for Dedicated control-plane, 99.9% for data-plane request availability. Latency SLO: p95 <= 120ms for small-gen workloads (subject to instance type). We'll publish a clear table in the GA notes.
emily: onboarding docs + terraform examples — who owns? also do we provide a migration tool from hosted to dedicated?
tara: product + docs will own onboarding flow. I'll pair with eng-platform for Terraform examples. Migration: yes, a guided flow that lets customers pin model versions and move traffic gradually.
vikram: infra note  dedicated requires private VPC peering for some customers, need an infra checklist for networking and IAM pre-reqs. I'll add that.
deploy-bot: scheduled task created: "dedicated-ga-checklist" assigned to #eng-platform for 2026-07-20.
maria: key action owners: 1) GA announcement draft + comms plan (tara + marketing) - due 2026-07-30; 2) onboarding docs + Terraform examples (tara + eng-platform) - due 2026-08-01; 3) migration playbook + sample scripts (sam? actually we didn't have sam in AH) - owner: diego - due 2026-08-05; 4) SLA docs and measurement dashboard (vikram + eng-sre) - due 2026-07-25; 5) customer beta cohort & invites (sales ops + jon) - list by 2026-07-10; 6) billing/meters verification (finance) - complete by 2026-07-20.
jon: I'll own the beta list + coordinate with AMs. target: 30 customers for soft-launch.
diego: migration playbook will include a small script + sample traffic-shift snippet; I'll add a CLI quick-test.
emily: can we get a short terraform snippet in the docs? propose adding this minimal example to the onboarding page:
```
provider "redwood" {
  api_key = var.redwood_key
  region  = "us-west-2"
}

resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "fast-gen" {
  name       = "fast-gen-prod"
  instance_type = "g5.2xlarge"
  capacity   = 10
}
```
vikram: network checklist: VPC peering, route tables, KMS key access, customer firewall rules. I'll paste the checklist in #eng-infra thread today.
tara: comms note  we'll do a staged email + in-product banner for early cohort, then full announcement on 2026-09-16. I'll draft copy and share for review by 2026-07-25.
emily: docs/UI question: show cost-estimate calc for dedicated vs hosted in the console? that will help sales.
maria: yes, cost-estimator widget is product backlog item; we'll try to land a minimal calc by GA. owner: eng-platform + finance.
deploy-bot: reminder: "dedicated-ga-checklist" ping in #eng-platform at 3710000120.
jon: risks flagged from AH: (a) billing edge cases for reserved capacity, (b) networking onboarding friction, (c) support staffing during soft-launch. We should surface these in the risk register.
maria: agree. quick mitigation owners: billing (finance), networking (eng-infra), support staffing (ops + support lead). add to the product risk doc.
diego: tech follow-up  do we support bring-your-own-model on Dedicated at GA or is that post-GA?
maria: BYOM is post-GA (we'll call out timeline in the RFC). GA supports models from our curated catalog + pinned customer artifacts. BYOM roadmap item slated for Q4 2026.
vikram: monitoring hook  ensure customers can forward metrics to their Datadog/Prometheus; add export hooks. I'll coordinate with eng-sre.
tara: marketing note  need a one-pager for sales to use in demos. I'll produce a draft.
emily: ownership recap in one line? who should I ping to land the Terraform examples?
tara: ping @eng-platform (owner: lee) and me, I'll coordinate reviews.
maria: final quick links: RFC: https://redwood.example.com/rfc/dedicated-ga-2026, AH slides: https://slides.redwood.example.com/ah-jun-2026#dedicated, onboarding draft: https://docs.redwood.example.com/dedicated/onboarding-draft. I'm opening follow-up threads in #eng-platform and #eng-infra for the detailed workstreams. ping me if you want to be added to the owners list. thanks all! :tada:
